title: Live agent roster
responsibility: Refreshes the selected project agent roster and derives freshness-aware sessions and module assignments.

inputs.name: createAgentRosterStore.workspace
inputs.description: The workspace state whose `projectId` scopes the roster and whose optional `bridge.agentActivity` reader supplies samples during refresh. Refresh records an unavailable message when either is missing and ignores a result if the workspace project changes before it resolves.

outputs.name: createAgentRosterStore
outputs.description: The created reactive state exposes the current-project sample, loading and error state, working count, labeled sessions, active module assignments, `refresh`, and `listen`. It hides a stored sample when the workspace project changes, prevents overlapping refreshes, and `listen` refreshes every 15 seconds and when the document becomes visible, returning cleanup to stop the timer and remove the visibility listener.
